DIAGNOSIS READY: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD).

I have noted the patient is somnolent and confused, and I have requested the MRI brain images to confirm the characteristic findings. The combination of rapidly progressive dementia, myoclonus (implied by agitation/falls), and visual or cerebellar signs is highly suggestive of this condition, not gastroenteritis.
